description: Source file implementing the ReportingService class for handling reporting tasks, including queueing reports, processing headers, managing browsing data, and interfacing with reporting cache and context.

classes.name: ReportingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ReportingService interface, managing report queueing, header processing, data removal, and interaction with reporting cache and context.

methods.name: SetDocumentReportingEndpoints
methods.description: Sets reporting endpoints for a document, scheduling the task if necessary.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSource
methods.description: Sends reports for a source and marks it as expired.

methods.name: QueueReport
methods.description: Queues a report with specified parameters after sanitizing URL and checking delegate permissions.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader
methods.description: Processes a reporting policy header string, parsing JSON content.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes browsing data based on data type mask and origin filter.

methods.name: RemoveAllBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes all browsing data matching the data type mask.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown procedures for the reporting service.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns the status of the reporting service as a JSON value.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Returns reporting endpoints grouped by origin.

methods.name: AddReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the reporting cache.

methods.name: RemoveReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the reporting cache.

methods.name: GetContextForTesting
methods.description: Provides access to the reporting context for testing purposes.
